# Overview {-}

This site documents the `placenta-poe-pfas` pipeline: parent-of-origin effects
(POE) on placental gene and isoform expression in GUSTO mother-father-infant
trios, and their modification by prenatal PFAS exposure.

| Chapter | Content |
|---|---|
| [Workflow](workflow.html) | stage diagram, inputs, how to run, methods per stage, outputs, caveats |
| [Genotyping methods](genotyping-methods.html) | arrays, sample and SNP QC, genotype processing |
| [Reports](reports.html) | rendered analysis reports |
| [Configuration](config-files.html) | `config/paths.sh` and `config/resources.sh` |

The pipeline runs on an LSF cluster through `run_pipeline.sh`; every stage is a
folder of job scripts and R / Python drivers, with the shared model code in `R/`.

Funding: NIH R21 (NIH RePORTER project 11437481).
